svg.title: The same Run, from a terminal
svg.desc: A synthetic split screen: the terminal starts race with work from game.md and watches r_7 until settled. The HarnessDesk window follows the same Run: Codex and Claude Code work, each passes four checks, then Gemini judges. Claude Code is Picked and Codex is Not kept as the stream settles with exit 0. The ten-second loop becomes this final state with reduced motion.

g.text: Claude Code is the stronger attempt.
